text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh~~~!! Ai-san, just a little 
more...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ai, are you for real?! Are you for 
reaaal?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...It's decided.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye!! It's Almond Eyeeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has overcome the wall of Rudolf the 
"Emperor"!! That's 8 turf GⅠ victories 
achieved……!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (O-O-O-Oh!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Almond Eyyyyeーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Tears welled up. The future I had dreamed 
of that day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right now, it is right before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah...! Yeahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "I won...! Ahhh!! I won~~~~...!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. I've finally been surpassed, 
have I?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The logic is clear. The "Umamusume capable 
of achieving that" is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It was you. Because you were... the very 
embodiment of those eyes—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't shine just because I want to. 
There is only—one single thing there.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I want to win."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just like that... light on your feet, 
running straight and true— you were the 
only one who could fly toward the finish 
line.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, that's a true protagonist for 
ya. A simple motivation is the coolest 
kind of all!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Aiiiiii! Congraaaats!!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Congraaaats! Congratulations~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Blast-chan! Shouldn't you be heading over 
to Ai-chan's?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I wanna go, but... gotta resist! I'm with 
Trainer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah... You're right. Both of them are 
crying—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. So that's an accelerator of 
yours too, huh!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye! Almond Eye! Almond Eye! Almond 
Eye! Almond Eye! Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm... so happy...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So many people are rejoicing... and 
sending their cheers to me—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"And that makes me so helplessly— 
happy...!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you... so much...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Thank you...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...With this, the racing world will 
advance once more. Striving to surpass her 
great achievement, the next generation 
will be inspired—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Another link of hope for the future has 
been connected. This... is good."

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
—Still, though, this doesn't mean I'm the 
strongest, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Well, Ai is strong. She's strong, but... 
compared to all the girls up until now, 
the reality is--

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You want to know, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Between her and the strongest Umamusume of 
all time— who is truly greater?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: B-But... how could we possibly do that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tremble tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It seems they feel the same way too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. After savoring the lingering 
taste of victory and just as we were about 
to decide on our next target race—

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"‘We interrupt this program with breaking 
news! Switching over to live coverage 
now—’"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"T.M. Opera O. Vodka. Gentildonna. Kitasan 
Black."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—Symboli Rudolf. These five will be 
competing in this year's Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Every single 7-time Turf G1 winning 
Umamusume, all lined up together...! 
Wh-Why now of all times—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘Almond Eye. Naturally, she is the 
reason.’"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘Every one of us built an era. Now, she 
is surpassing all of it, heading toward a 
new horizon—’"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—Then, let us challenge the past as well. 
Let us press forward. To decide who truly 
stands unrivaled at the pinnacle.”

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooooohh...!!" "A true battle to decide 
the strongest...!!" "—THIS is the kind of 
race I've always wanted to see!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Almond Eye, you haven't changed at 
all. It seems that we were the ones... 
changed by you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘To the Umamusume who has achieved all— 
this is a challenge from the past.’"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I have soared back to the 'present.' 
—What will you do?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I—
choice_data_list: I want to beat every single one of them!
We've gotta beat every single one of them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is a golden opportunity. Her name 
will be remembered for all eternity— I 
will prove that Almond Eye is the 
strongest.
choice_data_list: I want to see you beat them!
I want to see you beat them!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, yes... Wait, WHAT?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to win! The strength of those 
people who were called amazing—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—I want to surpass them head-on! I want to 
show everyone that I can overcome them!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll take on the challenge! Let's run in 
the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We're up against legendary Umamusume, 
tougher than anyone before. And there's 
hardly any time left until the race...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
We need to level up in a short amount of 
time, right? ...In that case!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I challenge you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's simple!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You challenge my capacity for growth. I 
challenge your imagination."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As long as we keep pushing each other to 
surpass our limits— we can go anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it, right? —You are my 
Trainer, after all!"
choice_data_list: ...I can do this! Let's settle this, Ai!
...I can do this! Let's race, Ai!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! My pace-keeping was totally 
flawless, wasn't it...?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —First win goes to me!
choice_data_list:
Kuh... The next menu item won't go down 
easy!

Kuh... The next menu item's gonna be 
tough!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! I won't lose this time 
either!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, how benevolent♪ Even though you were 
the one who stoked the flames~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding... Or could it be that I was 
just getting riled up?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave that to your imagination. One 
thing is certain, though—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—The way they carry themselves is as pure 
as clear skies and the autumn moon."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The racing world doesn't advance on talent 
alone. The two of them were always right 
there, driving it forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Umamusume and humans. The two have 
elevated one another... continually 
breaking down walls and evolving together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I get to challenge the two who are at the 
forefront. —Nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Truly—it is beautiful.
